inlines.v: SOL'ITARINESS, noun The state of being alone; forbearance of company; retirement, or habitual retirement. At home, in wholesome solitariness 2. Solitude; loneliness; destitution of company or of animated beings; applied to place; as the solitariness of the country or of a wood.
